• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* OGCs\, Aviation\, Metals/Auto\, Chemicals \(Agrochemicals\)\, Infrastructure
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* Pharma
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Identified macro risks like fuel\, fertilizer\, and capital access may lead to a risk\-off environment for foreign investors\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Consider underweighting sectors exposed to rising input costs and capital constraints\, such as OGCs and Metals/Auto\, while selectively looking for opportunities in Pharma due to long\-term growth forecasts\.
